items.title: Bitcoin falls below $60K for first time since July amid broader market selloff
items.summary: Bitcoin fell nearly 6% as US stocks declined, with the Nasdaq dropping more than 2% and Anthropic shares losing almost 10%.

items.title: Bitcoin Breaks Below $60K as Crypto Fear Index Hits Worst Level Since February
items.summary: Bitcoin broke below $60,000 Friday as crypto sentiment collapsed and AI-linked stocks sank after Anthropic's IPO.

items.title: Bitcoin Price Crashes to $59,000 as Market Selloff Deepens
items.summary: Bitcoin fell below $60,000 for the first time since early July on Friday as a tech stock rout, rate hike bets and record ETF outflows hit risk assets. This post Bitcoin Price Crashes to $59,000 as Market Selloff Deepens first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: Bitcoin price drops to $60K as Anthropic drops to $87 in tech sell-off
items.summary: Bitcoin price strength felt pressure from falling US equities as traders reassessed AI prospects after Anthropic's IPO.

items.title: Block Says Most Bitcoin Payments on Square Are for Coffee and Food
items.summary: Block's first bitcoin payments report found the median Square payment is about $13, with 72% at food and drink businesses, as it pushes for a de minimis tax exemption. This post Block Says Most Bitcoin Payments on Square Are for Coffee and Food first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: Bitcoin Hovers Just Above Average Holder's Cost Basis as Price Keeps Dipping
items.summary: Bitcoin is trading barely above its realized price, the average cost of every coin, and a break below would put the average holder at a loss for the first time since early 2023. items.title: Bitcoin Price Slips Near $61,500 as Tech Selloff Spreads to Asia
items.summary: The bitcoin price slipped to near $61,500 on Friday morning, its lowest level since July, as the tech selloff spread to Asia and IBIT posted a record outflow. This post Bitcoin Price Slips Near $61,500 as Tech Selloff Spreads to Asia first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: Live news: Bitcoin slips to fresh lows below $60,000 as Anthropic slides after Nasdaq debut
items.summary: BlackRock's bitcoin ETF saw a record $541.1 million outflow as the U.S. tech selloff spread to Asia, sending South Korea's Kospi down more than 5%.
